Hi Irene,

We're starting our DPA onboarding for Helix Health and have a couple of immediate asks to validate our risk assessment for UK patients. Can you confirm the following and, if possible, share artifacts by EOD next Wednesday?

1) Current subprocessor exposure map (which subprocessors may process data for UK-resident flows; region-by-region).
2) Short TIA/TIA-summary that explains where Redwood relies on SCCs vs. UK IDTA/UK addendum, and whether any conditional routing applies.
3) A checklist of evidence items you can provide for auditors (encryption, retention carveouts, logging/escrow access).

We are under a procurement timeline and would appreciate a clear list + a proposed signoff path for the UK addendum (DocuSign or counter-redlines). If there's an internal owner we should talk to about operational routing (edge/onshore fallback), please loop them in.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that speeds things up.
